messages:
Maria S: Quick: Scanline (large media) wants a BYO-KMS POC. Key asks: HSM-backed CMKs, sign/decrypt latency target <15ms, 99.95% BH availability, pen-test on 2024-11-15. They also want a rotation pattern that avoids app changes. Can we scope?
Alex W: Clarify: are they leaning Private (VPC) or Dedicated w/ HSM proxy?
Maria S: Prefer Private (VPC) but open to Dedicated if it meets latency/throughput. Cross-region failover is required for DR.
Jamal K: For <15ms ops we need the HSM close to the runtime. Options: (A) Redwood Private deployed in their VPC with their CloudHSM, (B) Dedicated + HSM proxy colocated in same AZ. Remote on-prem HSM will break the latency SLA.
Olivia (Solutions): Need expected QPS for key ops to size proxy/HSM.
Maria S: They said ~400 sign ops/s peak, ~100 sustained, highly bursty during transcoding jobs.
Jamal K: 400 TPS signing is heavy. Recommend ephemeral content encryption keys (CEKs) and wrapping; that reduces HSM QPS substantially (roughly 8-12x drop). We'll also add local cache of unwrapped CEKs for short-lived reuse.
Alex W: Customer asks for firewall/egress details and attestation docs. Can we provide a minimal network snippet now?
Olivia (Solutions): Draft snippet to hand to sec team:
- Redwood egress: 34.128.12.9/32, 34.128.12.10/32
- mTLS required, port 8443
- Allowed egress to cust HSM subnet: 10.10.0.0/24
- Keepalive 30s, idle timeout 300s
Jamal K: Also note: if they bring on-prem HSM across a tunnel, we cannot guarantee <15ms. Recommend either colocated HSM in region or Dedicated edge with high-bandwidth link.
Maria S: Pricing ask: what's delta between Dedicated+proxy vs Private with pass-through BYO-HSM? Need ballpark for procurement today.
Olivia (Solutions): Ballpark: Dedicated reserved pool + managed HSM proxy ~ $18k/mo (incl. GPU reserve). Private with pass-through (customer-managed HSM) has higher setup and platform fee, estimate $25k/mo first year (setup heavy). Exact depends on reserved GPU size and egress.
DeployBot: Preflight created: POC-Scanline-BYO-2024-Q4. Checklist items: network test, perf baseline, sec questionnaire, SOW/price approval.
LegalBot: Send customer sec-qa link (https://redwood.internal/sec-qa) and request HSM vendor attestation (FIPS cert + vendor POA). Flag export-control review for some algos.
Jamal K: Rotation note: our automatic rotation currently has a brief rewrap window (~10-30s). For "zero-app-change" rotation we can: 1) provision next CMK in HSM with same policy, 2) serve both keys concurrently (overlap window) and 3) prefer new key gradually. That requires SOW ops runbook and minor SDK behavior to fetch both handles; alternate is ephemeral CEK pattern to avoid per-op rewraps.
Alex W: Timeline question: pen-test 11/15; customer needs final config by 10/30. Can we hit that?
Jamal K: Tight but doable: need network + perf by 10/20. Provisioning Dedicated pool + proxy ~2 weeks, perf tuning 1 week.
Olivia (Solutions): Proposed SOW timeline: Kickoff 10/07, network tests 10/11, provision 10/14-10/21, perf baseline 10/22-10/25, freeze 10/30.
Maria S: Action items: @Jamal K confirm proxy capacity + ops runbook EOW. @Olivia draft SOW + pricing and send to me. @LegalBot send sec-qa + attestations to customer. I'll reply to Scanline with timeline and provisional pricing.
Maria S: One more: can they use an on-prem appliance and tunnel to Redwood?
Jamal K: Technically yes, but latency risk. We'll include it as a risk in SOW and cannot certify sub-15ms unless HSM is colocated in same AZ/VPC.
Olivia (Solutions): I'll include BYO-onprem option but mark as high-risk for latency. Draft SOW tomorrow.
Maria S: Thanks team, I'll update the customer and post back with security contact and the completed sec-qa. :thumbsup:
